ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 75% high-intensity off-white pixels versus 25% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous blobs on the lateral fields of both lobes. Low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central notch region, extending as a narrow band along the entire trailing edge. High-frequency stippled mottling occurs at the transition zones between high and low intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 62 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical bounding-box height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and continuous serrated boundary; high-frequency peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3-8 pixels along the trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral concave sweep trajectory along the outer margins of the trailing edge, tapering toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 10 high-relief, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacles) on the left distal tip; smaller cluster of 3-4 similar structures on the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) crossing the high-intensity fields; notable horizontal rake marks on the right lobe and short, multi-directional marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent colonization of acorn barnacles on both distal tips; various dark linear rake marks cutting through the white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique feathered pigmentation pattern where the central black region meets the lateral white lobes, creating a stippled gradient effect.
